title: Easton Farmers' Market
desc: Easton's been doing this since 1752: the country's oldest continuous open-air market. Come early for the best pick.

title: Easton Farmers' Market (Wednesday)
desc: The midweek market on the Circle, June through September. A good way to end a workday.

title: After-work vinyl set
desc: Soul and funk 45s after work. Come browse while you listen.

title: Trivia night
desc: Teams of up to six. The winners take home a bottle.

title: Comedy night
desc: A touring headliner with a local opener.

title: Toddler story time
desc: Picture books, songs and a craft, for ages 1 to 4 and their grown-ups.

title: Open studio: print a tote
desc: Pull your own two-color print on a tote bag and take it home.

title: Art after dark walk
desc: Galleries and studios stay open late. Grab a walking map on the Circle.

title: Pasta-making class
desc: Make two pasta shapes by hand, then eat them.

title: Kids' craft morning
desc: Drop in for crafts at the play table.

title: Riverfront concert
desc: Bring a blanket and sit by the water.

title: Trail cleanup
desc: Gloves and bags provided. Meet at the trail sign.

title: Ceramics sale
desc: Seconds and new planters, priced to go.
